verdict.rationale: Data portability and lock-in are fair questions for a desktop Linux distribution, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack documents no feature for exporting user data in open formats or for migrating away. The automatic snapshots (omarchy-snapshot) are system rollback points, not data export. The community suggestion to read the repo and reuse parts on another distro is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
